title: A service says where it happens: an address, a phone number or a video link, in the booking page, the email and the invite

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: space_service_types has no location column and nothing in booking-notify sends one, so a booker never learns where to go or which link to join. This is Calendly's most used event-type field (in person, phone, Zoom, Google Meet, custom link, ask the invitee). Fix: location_kind plus location_value on space_service_types (additive migration), shown on the picker, in the confirmation, the reminder and the .ics LOCATION. A video link can be per booking later (generated Meet links need calendar sync).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
